commentaryEvent.comment: The Blues open up the second half with back-to-back goals from forward half clearance wins. In the last six weeks, Carlton sit equal with Adelaide for the most goals of any side sourced from forward half clearance chains with 19 goals.
Carlton have played on immediately from 16 of their 68 marks in the first half. By comparison, Fremantle have not played on immediately from any of their 25 marks in the first half.

Fremantle have been held to just eight marks between the 50 metre arc's in the first half of today's match. Today is the first time the Dockers have recorded less than 10 marks in the midfield in a half of football since they recorded six marks in midfield in the first half of Round 10, 2017 against Adelaide.
Carlton have won the first half pressure battle 190-171 in today's match. That is their largest first-half advantage in the pressure rating metric since Round 13, 2025 against Essendon.
The siren has sounded to end Q2.

Michael Frederick saves the Dockers from their first goalless quarter since their famous Round 18 win over Sydney. That goal was just their second of the match kicked in general play. They have scored 769 points from general play in 2026, the fewest points from this source of any side in the Top 8 on the ladder.

Jagga Smith, Cooper Lord and Sam Walsh have each recorded 10 handball-receive's in the first half. That is twice the total of Fremantle's best players in this metric (Shai Bolton and Patrick Voss have five each).

Fremantle have not generated an inside 50 from their six defensive half possession chains in the second term. By comparison, the Blues have generated four inside 50's from 11 defensive half chains resulting in two goals this quarter.

Two-thirds of Fremantle's kicks in their forward half were effective in the first term of today's match. In the second term however, only one-third of their kicks have been effective in their attacking half.
With his first disposal of this quarter, Jacob Weitering has recorded his 3000th career disposal in game 216.

After providing the assist for the first goal of the term, Sam Walsh records his game-high sixth score involvement of the match with his first goal of the match. He ranks 10th in the AFL for total score involvements in 2026 with 173.
Eight of Fremantle's nine turnovers in the opening term were giveaways. By comparison, just two of Carlton's eight turnovers were giveaways.
Fremantle scored from seven of their nine inside 50's in the opening term. No team has converted a higher percentage of their inside 50's into scores in 2026 than the Dockers (50.4%).

Carlton have won four of their five attacking one-on-one contests in the opening term. They have won 26% of their offensive one-on-one's over the last six weeks, ranking them 12th in the AFL in this regard.
The siren has sounded to end Q1.
Dockers Interchange - Brennan Cox and is possibly out for the game.
Francis Evans kicks back-to-back goals to bring the margin back within a goal. Over the last six weeks, Evans has recorded the fifth-most player rating points among general forwards (72.7).

In the last 10 minutes of the match, Carlton have won the pressure battle convincingly, recording a rating of 178 to Fremantle's 141. Since Round 18, the Blues have averaged a pressure rating of 181, ranked fifth in the AFL.
Harry McKay gets the first goal for Carlton on the board. All of their eight points so far have been scored from set shots. Since Round 10, Carlton's 108 goals from set shots ranks third in the AFL.

Despite Carlton's clearance advantage early in the first term, three of Fremantle's four goals have been sourced from stoppage clearances, including the last two in quick succession. Since Round 18, the Dockers have outscored their opponents by 15 points per game from clearance chains, the second-best average score margin from this source of any side during this period.

Carlton have won six of the first eight clearances so far in the first term. The Blues have outperformed their opponents by an average of 1.5 clearances per game, the fifth-best clearance margin of any side since Round 10.
Dockers Interchange - Jordan Clark off due to an injury.

Oscar McDonald opens the scoring with a major. He had kicked just seven goals in his 103 career matches before today. Coincidentally, the last team he kicked a goal against was Carlton in Round 21, 2025.

This match is an unofficial top of the table clash. Since Josh Fraser took over the reigns at Carlton in Round 10, Fremantle (11) and Carlton (10) are the only two teams to amass 10 or more wins prior to the beginning of this Round.

Fremantle has converted 29% of Shai Bolton's inside 50 entries via his kicks into goals in 2026. This is the best goal conversion rate among the Top 50 players for total kicks inside 50 in the competition this year.
Between Rounds 18-23, no team has recorded more intercept marks than the 106 taken by Carlton during this period.

Since Josh Fraser has taken over as Carlton coach in Round 10, George Hewett is one of five players in the AFL who has helped their team win 10% more centre clearances than their opponents when he has attended a centre stoppage during this period.

Fremantle's possession retention rate over the course of the 2026 season has been 3.2% higher than that of their combined opponents this season. No other team in the league has recorded an advantage of over 3% in this metric this year.
